scope: I07 bounded Bollinger-only standalone research. User delegated next study; no live/ladder changes, combinations or HL/SR.
formula: Current-inclusive closed-window SMA of N closes; population SD sqrt(sum((close-mean)^2)/N), two-pass centered arithmetic, no E[x^2]-mean^2 cancellation. Bands=mean +/- K*SD; %b=(close-lower)/(upper-lower), bandwidthPct=100*(upper-lower)/mean, closeMinusMiddle=close-mean. First N-1 rows null. Zero SD valid width0 but %b=null (no crossing); midpoint exit may use valid zero closeMinusMiddle. No rounding/gap reseed. 20/2 standard reference; 50 and3 are sensitivity choices, not asserted matched-containment settings.

entryRules.breakout: Long previous %b<=1,current>1; short previous>=0,current<0. Closed outside-band continuation, not intrabar high/low touch.
entryRules.into: Long previous %b>0,current<=0; short previous<1,current>=1. Fade fresh close into/outside band; no continued-state entry.
entryRules.reclaim: Long previous %b<=0,current>0; short previous>=1,current<1. Both values use own closed current-inclusive bands; band movement may cause crossing without price rebound.

exitRules: 12h from fill or earliest subsequent midpoint condition capped at12h. Breakout long close<=middle / short>=middle; into/reclaim long close>=middle / short<=middle. Not a TP or stop; current midpoint moves. Timeout wins ties; no entry-time exit; immutable pending.
timing: Contiguous finalized selected-timeframe bars; next minute-open, modeled0 publication lag or separate+1m every entry and exit. Full fixed seed; no execution-minute H/L/C at decision, no future bar or sliding reseed.
inventory: One independent $10k position; no compounding/averaging. Occupied/pending crossings skipped, fresh signal after exit. Open cutoff inventory marked including hypothetical close fee; not counted as completed.
funding: Excluded due incomplete settlement evidence. After trading fees before funding; no liquidation/shared-account/queue/live fills certification.
researchScreen: Same inherited screen: >=30full/10recent closes in both delays, positive net and own-side clock delta allfour; no monthly marked delta below-1e-8; positive extra5bps/side and no equity exhaustion.
ranking: All240 by full0m delta versus own-side clock, also absolute net per side. Descriptive sample/net/stress/solvent subset allfour cases, rank full0m absolute net; top5 if available else rawtop5, failures retained. No relaxed deployment gate.
reporting: Baselines alongside W/L counts/dollars, net/open/DD; full/recent periods, monthly top5 and rawtop5, both delays/cost stress, all240 definitions, own-entry12h exit deltas, worst paths/winner concentration. If subset<5 retain actual subset size, do not pad with failures.
overlapParity: 8 prior clock cases exact old/new/saved I01 ledgers/months/stats/open BEFORE new outcomes. No prior standalone Bollinger definitions repeated. Independent synthetic accounting and formula fixtures.
limitations: 240 correlated previously-mined definitions, overlapping windows; not holdout. No additional windows/widths, EMA bands, intrabar touches, squeeze percentile/expansion rule, Donchian/Keltner, stops/targets/trailing/partials, indicators/HL/SR, ladder/portfolio. Band tag not assumed reversal; %b and bandwidth are not independent signals.
writes: New local artifact directory only, refuse overwrite, source/data fingerprints unchanged; findings/register updates after independent verification. No commit/push/live changes.
